title: Mossy Green Mangrove
description: Recolors mangrove to pair with mossy stone
body:
This pack recolors mangrove wood to be a lush green that works well alongside mossy stone and mossy cobblestone.

![All blocks in the mangrove wood set have been recolored to complement the green in mossy stone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29c8b809a2dc90d5cf8b5aa47ea011c59fac4410.jpeg)

It includes compat for the following mods:

- Another Furniture
- Balanced Crates
- Building But Better
- The Block Box
- Boatload
- Bountiful Fares
- Charm
- Cozy
- Create
- Decorative Blocks
- Dramatic Doors
- Farmer's Delight
- Friends & Foes
- Hearth & Home
- Hearth and Harvest
- Lucky's Cozy Home
- Modern Glass Doors
- MrCrayfish's Furniture Mod: Refurbished
- Player Shops
- Quark
- Re:Deco
- Redecorate
- Shutter Up
- Snowy Spirit
- Storage Delight
- Storage Drawers
- Supplementaries
- Tutta's Doors
- Twigs
- Woodworks

If you like this pack, check out my other recolors: [Ashy Gray Acacia](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ashy-gray-acacia) and [Jet-Black Jungle](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/jet-black-jungle)
